rationale: validateWorkflowDefinition casts untrusted parsed YAML directly to WorkflowConfig, after which validateWorkflowActions treats node.action as a string without runtime type validation. For action: null, the supported-action lookup fails and findClosestSupportedAction passes null to levenshteinDistance, which immediately reads a.length and throws a TypeError instead of the intended actionable configuration error. The added tests cover string typos, removed aliases, unknown strings, and valid strings, but omit null and other non-string YAML values.
